description: Apply ADMIN_BALANCE to one existing NOT_FUNDED milestone without creating a duplicate. Zero money moves and no Stripe charge or PaymentIntent is created; later payout/release remains human-only. Requires the same fail-closed canonical-admin organization, platform-admin, Admin Pay allowlist, token-organization, scope, and rollout checks as admin-balance creation. Contract/milestone linkage and compensation are verified, and request-bound idempotency makes retries converge.

idempotencyKey.description: Request-bound idempotency key. Reuse the same key for safe retries.

name: opentrain_fund_admin_balance_milestone
